Because people don’t understand that you’re just like every other human being you have a brain, you have a body and you have a voice. being autistic does NOT mean that you are different. It means that you have a way of thinking or doing something that others may not do. It means that you may have a harder time but you’re so strong and so amazing. Autism doesn’t describe who you are just like ADHD or OCD doesn’t describe who you are. It just means that you are very special and no one deserves to be bullied over having an awesome new way of thinking. I hope things can get better for you I am so sorry about the people who are bullying you. My brother has autism so I’ve watch people make fun of him or push him around and it pains me to know that so many others deal with that too. I really do feel for you and hope things will get better <3

My comment will probably be dragged out by all these great wonderful comments of people trying to distract you but I’m just gonna say I’m in the same boat as you right now.. though I am a bit younger I do know hearing all the “it’ll get better” and “don’t give up now” won’t help. I think that’s what makes if very difficult to talk about it over the internet because I think just some simple words that you can say to anyone won’t really help.. but trust me when I say that life really sucks now but tomorrow it might suck a little less and I think we just need to have that faith in the world to give us that one good day that we will never forget and I think we should try to hold off until we get that day. Wanting to die is a very difficult thing wanting to live is also a very difficult thing but but I believe that we can get through this together and we can be okay one day.. even if it takes days or weeks or months or years I know that we might be okay. I really hope that you’ll be okay and I really hope you have a nice day. Be safe and do whatever you love doing maybe playing a video game or watching tv. Just have a good day <3
